lines: ({player} knocks on the window. Tap, tap, tap.)
Coming, coming! Oh, hello, {player}! What can I do for you?
{player}: Mr. Palmer, I'm Rex's campaign manager. He wants to be mayor! Here are his ideas.
({player} tells him about the bike lane, the flowers, the lamps and the naps in the sun.)
Those are lovely ideas. Really lovely.
But I'm afraid the answer is no. Not this year. I'm still the mayor, and the next election isn't until next year.
{player}: Oh. Rex is going to be sad.
Tell him this from me: a good mayor is patient. And a good mayor listens to everybody before deciding anything.
And it sounds like he's already started. He asked the whole town! Even Rook!
Tell him to keep listening. And I'll put Bramble's flowers in the window boxes right away. Goodbye, {player}!
({player} knocks. Nobody answers. The curtains are closed.)
(A little sign on the window says: OFFICE HOURS: MORNING TILL TEATIME. Mr. Palmer)

rotate: Hello, {player}! Tell Future Mayor Rex the window flowers are coming along nicely.
Still listening to everybody? Good! Me too.

lines: ({player} knocks on the window. Tap, tap, tap.)
Hello there! I'm Mr. Palmer, the mayor of Galaxity. Lots of paperwork today!
{player}! Welcome. My door is always open. Well... my window is.

rotate: Busy, busy! The town map needs updating again. Somebody moved the whole market!
Being mayor is mostly listening. And signing things. So many things.
(Mr. Palmer is on the phone.) Yes... yes... no, the portal is NOT a swimming pool. Goodbye!
